title: Breakthrough Comes When You Give God Something to Work With
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals how God's ways are not our ways, and how we must give Him something to work with to experience breakthrough and abundance. By looking at the story of Elijah and the widow, Pastor Chris shows us how to break free from fear and lack, and step into a season of extreme prosperity. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge and encourage you to obey God's voice in your giving and trusting in His promises.
